name: M. K. Bhan Research Programme (formerly M K Bhan Young Researcher Fellowship Programme, MKB-YRFP)
funder: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India
amount: Rs 90,000/month consolidated + research grant up to Rs 20 lakh/year (manpower, consumables, minor equipment, travel; capital equipment capped at Rs 10 lakh overall)
other_rules: PhD in life sciences, biotechnology or allied areas (submitted thesis allowed, fellowship starts on award)
cannot be held at the PhD institution
host must be a DBT autonomous institute
mentor must have at least 5 years before retirement
notes: Renamed "M. K. Bhan Research Programme" by DBT notice of 17 Jun 2026. Up to 50 awards a year; 3 years, extendable by 2 in exceptional cases. Call dates for the 2026-27 round not found; check fellowships.gov.in. Details from a Biotecnika summary of the 2025-26 guidelines.
